_note: Edit this file to add or remove sources. 'gate': true means items must contain a transport keyword to be kept (used for broad feeds like PIB). Google News queries are already targeted, so they use gate: false.

feeds.name: NHAI & national highway projects
feeds.query: NHAI OR "National Highways Authority of India" highway project

feeds.name: Highway awards & bids
feeds.query: NHAI highway project awarded OR bid OR "HAM" OR "BOT toll"

feeds.name: TOT & asset monetisation
feeds.query: "Toll Operate Transfer" OR "TOT bundle" OR "asset monetisation" highway India

feeds.name: Tolling, tariffs & FASTag
feeds.query: toll plaza OR toll rate OR FASTag OR "annual pass" India highway fee

feeds.name: Expressways under construction
feeds.query: expressway India construction progress OR opened OR commissioned

feeds.name: Highway closures & diversions
feeds.query: highway closed OR diversion OR landslide OR flood damage national highway India

feeds.name: Railways, new lines & capacity
feeds.query: Indian Railways new line OR doubling OR electrification project sanctioned

feeds.name: Dedicated Freight Corridor
feeds.query: "Dedicated Freight Corridor" OR DFCCIL freight traffic

feeds.name: Rail freight loading
feeds.query: Indian Railways freight loading OR originating traffic tonnes

feeds.name: Airports & aviation capacity
feeds.query: India airport new terminal OR expansion OR greenfield airport passenger traffic

feeds.name: Air traffic & routes
feeds.query: India domestic air passenger traffic DGCA OR new route airline

feeds.name: Ports & cargo throughput
feeds.query: India port cargo traffic OR throughput OR container volumes major ports

feeds.name: Shipping & trade routes
feeds.query: India shipping route OR freight rate OR Red Sea OR Suez impact trade

feeds.name: Logistics & Gati Shakti
feeds.query: India logistics cost OR "PM Gati Shakti" OR multimodal corridor

feeds.name: Fuel prices & transport cost

feeds.name: Mining, industry & freight demand

feeds.name: Global events affecting Indian trade

feeds.name: Macro demand indicators

feeds.name: Strikes, bandhs & disruptions
